verdicts.reason: A has the reading order upside down: the CTA sits above the headline, crammed near the top and off-centre, and the eyebrow line falls below the body copy. The terrazzo confetti is almost gone, there is a large dead band above the tiny logo and legal line, and the card has a stray clipped edge at the top right. B has a sensible split layout with intact confetti, book and colours, but the logo is shrunk to near-illegible, the legal text is tiny, the eyebrow comes after the body copy, the card bleeds off the left edge, and the CTA is not left-aligned with the text column.
